title: 2020 roadmap on pore materials for energy and environmental applications
claim: Immobilizing photocatalysts on an existing aerogel scaffold broadens the accessible material combinations compared with relying solely on direct photocatalyst sol–gel formation.
explanation: The scaffold route can accommodate photocatalysts lacking a workable sol–gel chemistry, whereas directly assembled aerogels may also be fragile because of weak connections between building blocks.
conditions: A compatible aerogel framework and immobilization method are required.
caveats: Inert silica or polymer scaffolds can impair light harvesting or charge transfer; conductive graphene scaffolds raise cost concerns.
